items.reason: Detail status menus use the container’s own status actions through the shared opener.
Detail `y` opens the container’s Copy menu without copying immediately.
Detail `m` opens the Mute menu for the detail’s container.
Both views dispatch `I` through the shared runFlatI helper.
The drain picker renders in the detail’s reserved modal block.
Direct `y` and `p` handlers are removed from document peeks.
Neither detail list handles flat `p`.
Existing item and artifact `r` menu routes remain intact, including peeks.
The shared status refusal reaches the detail hint line through detailFlash.
The shared copy refusal reaches the detail hint line through detailFlash.
The shared mute refusal reaches the detail hint line through detailFlash.
Container menus occupy a Frame Block included in the list’s height budget.
Detail menus delegate navigation and dispatch to the existing row-menu handlers.
Menu Escape clears the menu while retaining the detail.
Detail openers bypass Selection and create singular container menus.
Detail search narrows its lists, and Enter restores the detail keymap.
Shared filtering implements case-insensitive substring matching with AND across terms.
Item search fields contain only id, title and type.
Artifact filtering uses the shared grammar over name and type.
Escape discards the edit and reapplies the previously applied term.
Opening search initializes an empty buffer; applying it clears filtering.
The typing handler forwards ordinary keys, including j, k, v and r, to TextField.
Detail refresh reapplies its active query to rebuilt items and artifacts.
The applied term appears in the detail’s persistent subheader.
Search-hidden lists display an empty-state message naming the query and clearing sequence.
Artifact availability uses the unfiltered collection, preserving switching after filtering.
Detail search state is separately owned and discarded when the detail closes.
Detail hints advertise r, s, y, m and / without flat copy bindings.
Unchanged documentPeekChrome still advertises “y copy name” and artifact “p copy path”.
Typing hints name only apply, cancel and help.
Detail help lists the required menus, I and search; peek help removes flat copy entries.
Help handles container menus over details and has a dedicated detail-search branch.

scores.rationale: Shared handlers and filtering keep the implementation coherent, with broad supplied tests; stale peek hints expose a missing rendering check.
